SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: VICTOIRE MANAGEMENT SUPPORT (VMS), A RELATED NON PROFIT RELIGIOUS ORGANIZATION, PROVIDES MANAGEMENT, CONSOLIDATED PROCUREMENT SERVICES, AND ADMINISTRATIVE SUPPORT TO NAZARETH HOUSE OF SAN DIEGO INC. VICTOIRE MANAGEMENT SUPPORT (VMS), A RELATED NON PROFIT RELIGIOUS ORGANIZATION, PROVIDES MANAGEMENT, CONSOLIDATED PROCUREMENT SERVICES, AND ADMINISTRATIVE SUPPORT TO NAZARETH HOUSE OF SAN DIEGO, INC. VMS PROVIDES THE SAME MANAGEMENT SERVICES TO ALL FOUR OF THE NAZARETH HOUSES OPERATED BY THE CONGREGATION, AND IS COMPRISED OF THE CEO/PRESIDENT AND CFO/TREASURER.

THE SOLE MEMBER OF THE NAZARETH HOUSE OF SAN DIEGO, INC. IS THE CONGREGATION OF THE SISTERS OF NAZARETH MOTHER HOUSE USA, INC., WHILE THE SOLE MEMBER OF THE CONGREGATION OF THE SISTERS OF NAZARETH MOTHER HOUSE USA, INC. IS ITS SUPERIOR GENERAL.
THE ORGANIZATION HAS A MEMBER WHO ELECTS THE MEMBERS OF THE GOVERNING BODY.
SOME DECISIONS OF THE GOVERNING BODY ARE SUBJECT TO APPROVAL BY THE MOTHER HOUSE IN THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA AND BY THE MOTHER HOUSE IN ENGLAND (LEVELS OF APPROVAL).
THE FINANCE COMMITTEE HAS BEEN DESIGNATED TO REVIEW THE FORM 990 FOR ACCURACY AND COMPLETENESS BEFORE FILING WITH THE APPROPRIATE TAXING AUTHORITY AS RECOMMENDED BY THE INTERNAL REVENUE SERVICE.

ON AN ANNUAL BASIS, BOARD MEMBERS ARE REQUIRED TO DISCLOSE, SIGN, AND DATE ANY POTENTIAL CONFLICT OF INTERESTS WITH THE ORGANIZATION AND ARE REQUIRED TO UPDATE REGARDING ANY CONFLICT DURING THE YEAR AS NECESSARY.

IN EVALUATING COMPENSATION FOR EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR, AN INDEPENDENT PANEL MAKES STUDY USING COMPARATIVE DATA FROM CALIFORNIA ASSISTED LIVING ASSOCIATION AND MAKES RECOMMENDATION TO THE BOARD. THE BOARD APPROVES COMPENSATIONS.

THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS AND OFFICERS INCLUDE MEMBERS OF THE RELIGIOUS ORDER OF THE SISTERS OF NAZARETH WHO HAVE TAKEN A VOW OF POVERTY AND WHO ARE THEREFORE NOT COMPENSATED. IN HIRING COMPENSATED EMPLOYEES, AN INDEPENDENT PANEL MAKES A STUDY USING COMPARATIVE DATA FROM CALIFORNIA ASSISTED LIVING ASSOCIATION AND MAKES RECOMMENDATION TO THE BOARD. THE BOARD APPROVES COMPENSATIONS.
THE GOVERNING DOCUMENTS OF THE ORGANIZATION (ARTICLES OF INCORPORATION BYLAWS, CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY) ARE AVAILABLE UPON REQUEST.

THE PRIOR PERIOD ADJUSTMENT OF 50,756 REPRESENTS THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN 2022 FUND BALANCE OF 10,306,500 PER FORM 990 FILED ON 2/15/24, AND FUND BALANCE OF 10,255,744 PER AUDITED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS DATED 5/14/24. THE 2022 TAX RETURNS WERE FILED ON 2/15/24 TO MEET THE FILING DUE DATE--- BEFORE THE AUDIT WAS COMPLETED. APPARENTLY, THERE WERE 50,756 ADDITIONAL EXPENSES RECOGNIZED PER AUDITED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS. THE 2022 TAX RETURNS WOULD BE AMENDED IF NECESSARY.
